comparison.objective: Insert a rolled poster into a mailing tube and press caps into both ends; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-object coaxial insertion and two interference-fit cap insertions versus pouring and bridge-clearing through screen apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Roll at least 15 mm inside both ends, both caps aligned/seated, all parts released and still; candidate requires mass-based media recovery and washer retention.
comparison.reason: The mailing task tests coaxial packaging insertion rather than granular size/orientation separation.
